einzeiler: Bill Maher discusses politics, the White House, and social security with his guests.
kurzfassung: Bill Maher opens the show with a monologue covering current political events and his recent visit to the White House. He is then joined by former White House press secretary Caroline Leavitt for an interview about the administration. Later, California gubernatorial candidate Steve Hilton and Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear join the panel to debate the economy, foreign policy, and government spending.
stichpunkte: Bill Maher shares details from a four-hour dinner at the White House.
Caroline Leavitt discusses her time as the youngest press secretary in history and her upcoming role at Fox News.
Steve Hilton and Andy Beshear debate the economic challenges and political climate in California versus Kentucky.
The panel discusses voter fraud statistics and whether Republicans are focusing on a non-issue.
The conversation turns to foreign policy disagreements regarding Ukraine, Russia, and the impact of the war on diesel prices.
Andy Beshear promotes his new book focusing on faith and bridging political divides.
Bill Maher delivers a closing segment on the unsustainability of current government spending on older versus younger generations.

clips.text: The guest explains that the White House provides essential security for someone who has faced multiple assassination attempts.
The host reads off specific Justice Department statistics regarding the extremely low number of individuals charged with illegal voting out of tens of millions of registered voters.
A humorous list of fictional campaign slogans mocks the Democratic Party's attempts to project a tougher, more masculine image.
